name: Wormhole Gateway
desc: A lattice of field projectors that holds a Star Chart's coordinates steady long enough to tear a wormhole open to the charted system. Fleets docked here can open Star Chart wormholes.

name: Advanced Wormhole Gateway
desc: A retuned lattice whose field projectors hold coordinates that drift further from known space. Fleets docked here can open Star Chart wormholes to deeper systems.

name: Perfected Wormhole Gateway
desc: A lattice tuned against a full map of how the deepest charts fold. It holds any coordinates a Star Chart can reach.
